title: Big bands versus little bands, and an idea for a string ensemble
summary: Breaux prefers small Dixieland bands to big bands for money and enjoyment, and wants a string ensemble, but says work is scarce because of rock and roll.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
